MCC_policy: mltools::mcc() 0.3.5 native outputs; zero denominator returns zero
intervals: paired descriptive 95% Monte Carlo intervals; unadjusted
Oracle: reference only; excluded from winners and not a projection-risk lower bound
corrected_scale: c0 = max(0, (yc transpose v - sigmahat2 df0) / squared norm of v); zero if v is zero
sigmahat2: Training-subset tenfold CV-Lasso RSS / max(1, training size - selected slopes - 1); 11 variance estimates per replication
interpretation: Plug-in optimism correction with response-adaptive scaling and tuning; no unconditional unbiasedness or risk-dominance guarantee
